item.title: LARRY KUDLOW: Do not listen to the Schumer open border crowd
item.description: Democrats want to change immigration laws as the price of a CR deal to avoid a shutdown

item.title: Tariffs may have cost US economy thousands of jobs monthly, Fed analysis reveals
item.description: A new Fed study estimates tariffs cost the U.S. economy 19,000 jobs per month in 2025, potentially raising unemployment by 0.1 percentage points.

item.title: Nearly 100-year-old candy company files for bankruptcy amid rising costs, heavy debt: report
item.description: Nearly century-old Chicago candy maker Primrose Candy Co. files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, seeking to restructure over $12 million in debt.

item.title: San Francisco bakery faces online backlash for selling controversial 'F--- ICE' cookies
item.description: San Francisco's Devil's Teeth Baking Company sells cookies denouncing Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Owner Hilary Passman donates proceeds to the Minnesota Community Action Network.

item.title: Trump Accounts hit 1 million sign-ups after Nicki Minaj White House summit appearance, Bessent says
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced a Trump Accounts program update Thursday after a White House summit with the president and Nicki Minaj.

item.title: Ex-Google engineer found guilty of stealing AI secrets for Chinese companies
item.description: Former Google engineer Linwei Ding was convicted of stealing AI trade secrets and economic espionage after an 11-day trial. He was accused of taking proprietary data to benefit China.

item.title: Trump reveals when he will announce the next Fed chair
item.description: President Trump says he'll announce Jerome Powell's replacement as Federal Reserve chair Friday morning, escalating his ongoing criticism of monetary policy decisions.

item.title: Thousands of popular products, including Diet Coke, Pringles, recalled over rodent contamination concerns
item.description: Thousands of popular products, including Diet Coke, Cheerios and Pringles were recalled in several states due to rodent contamination concerns.

item.title: Kendall Jenner's ex Devin Booker challenges her $1M Patriots bet after Super Bowl ad references him
item.description: Kendall Jenner's viral Super Bowl ad for Fanatics Sportsbook sparked a playful exchange with ex-boyfriend Devin Booker over her million-dollar Patriots bet.

item.title: Trump threatens 50% tariff on Canadian aircraft in escalating Gulfstream certification fight
item.description: President Trump threatened a 50% tariff on Canadian aircraft unless Canada approves Gulfstream jets, accusing Ottawa of "illegally" blocking U.S. plane certification.
